title: QuickTextUsage - Data API
description: Represents the usage of quick text on a record, including which quick text was used, who used it, and how they used it. Quick text is a snippet of text that allows users to send a quick response to a customer. This object is available in API version 47.0 and later.

AppContext.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
AppContext.description: Context in which the quick text was used. Possible values are: Aloha—Salesforce Classic Lightning—Lightning Experience Unknown

Channel.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
Channel.description: The channel in which the quick text was used. Possible values are: Email Event Generic Internal Knowledge Live Agent Messaging Phone Portal Social Task

FolderId.description: ID of the folder containing the quick text at the time it was used. This is a relationship field.

LaunchSource.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
LaunchSource.description: How the user started the quick text. Possible values are: Floater Keyboard shortcut Macro Toolbar

LoggedTime.description: The time when the quick text was used.

OwnerId.description: ID of the group or user that owns the quick text. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

QuickTextID.description: ID of the quick text. This is a relationship field.

UserId.description: ID of the user that used the quick text. This is a relationship field.

associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. Unless noted, they are available in the same API version as this object.

- **QuickTextUsageChangeEvent (API version 62.0)**: Change events are available for the object.
- **QuickTextUsageOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **QuickTextUsageShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
